outline.rationale: The user is new to neural nets and wants deep intuition, not code or math. I open with a minimal neural-network foundation (node 1) since nothing else makes sense without weights/layers, then embeddings (node 2) as the bridge from language to numbers. Nodes 3–4 split the "why" and "how" of attention deliberately — the motivation (what problem) is distinct content from the mechanism (queries/keys/values intuition), keeping siblings MECE. Node 5 covers depth/stacking, node 6 covers positional encoding (a genuinely separate puzzle: order without recurrence). Node 7 synthesizes everything into an end-to-end trace, which is the conceptual through-line the user explicitly wanted. Node 8 closes the loop with training and generation intuition. I excluded the original paper's notation, coding setup, math derivations, performance/engineering, and history — all explicitly deprioritized. Eight nodes balance coverage with the no-overload constraint.
